description: Turns a social publishing automation on or off. Use when the user wants an automation to start posting on its schedule, or to stop or resume it after a channel reconnect. Not for posting once right now (use run_social_automation_now). Returns the new state and next run. Turning on needs a free active-automation slot on the plan.

action.description: activate = run on its schedule from the next run time; deactivate = stop it (kept as a draft, nothing deleted).

automation_id.description: ID of the publishing automation. Get it from list_social_automations.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: set_social_automation_state
title: Turn publishing automation on or off
